clips.title: The story
paras: At Fallen Sky Lake, a moonstone may be the only hope for Relara, whose fever has broken but whose strength is nearly gone. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sends you to the waters southeast of Astranaar, where a corrupted Shadethicket Oracle guards the fallen stones.

Pelturas Whitemoon has watched his young daughter, Relara, slip closer to death through days of illness. Remedies made from Bathran's hair and stardust broke her raging fever, but left her body hollow and frail. Pelturas fears she has only breaths remaining before her spirit fades permanently into the night.

Pelturas turns to moonstones to restore Relara's strength. These celestial fragments once fell into Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar, and night elves gathered them for their healing power. Aggressive elementals or corrupted bark now claim the stones, so gathering one means facing danger with blade and spell.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak. I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost. I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.
We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... Until the Shadethickets came.
Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them. Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.
And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, friend? If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, friend, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!
I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... Please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
